learning_objective: 🎯 Today we will discover the superpowers of different foods and learn how eating healthy keeps us strong and energetic!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Foods like rice, wheat, potatoes, and butter are like fuel for our bodies! They give us the energy to run, play, jump, and study all day long.
Want strong muscles and tall bones? You need body-building foods! Milk, pulses (dal), eggs, and nuts help our body grow big and fix any cuts or scrapes.
Fruits and green leafy vegetables are our superhero shields! They protect us from falling sick and keep our eyes and skin glowing and healthy.
Water is a magic drink for our body. It helps us digest our food and keeps us cool by sweating. We should drink plenty of clean water every single day!

fun_activity.title: 🎨 Rainbow Plate Challenge!
fun_activity.instructions: Next time you eat lunch, try to make your plate look like a rainbow! See if you can have at least 3 different colors of food on your plate, like yellow dal, green spinach, and white rice.

quick_recap: ⭐ Energy-giving foods give us the power to play and work.
⭐ Body-building foods like milk and dal help us grow strong.
⭐ Fruits and vegetables protect us from illnesses.
⭐ Drinking lots of water is very important for healthy digestion.
